title: Disappointing. Too heavy to be useful
text:
Disappointing. Too heavy to be useful. [[VIDEOID:6298e434137e626718c3d15e3c8b1301]] These don't look as good as I had hoped. We have a couple other magnetic tiebacks and really like them. I like bling, so thought these would be great. Not so much.

The sparkle part looks ok, although the plastic gems are sometimes not glued in the exact spot. But, these are constructed differently in a way that I do not care for. I made a short video to show folks how they fasten, and the cording on these.

The cords are not cords like on all my other tie-backs; these are metal and stretchy, like a 1970's necklace. Maybe they found a warehouse with old necklace cording amd wanted to use it up. But it adds nothing, and makes the tieback heavier.

The backs are flat and cheap plastic. It is harder to match up the magnet on these than it is for the others.

Overall, these get a "C" in my gradebook. Nice try, but too many design flaws to be really useful.
